title: Ship Tactus procedures in the wheel and resolve them by kind (S)
description:
The 11 core procedures in procedures/newsroom/*.tac are read from a Papyrus checkout. newsroom_commands.py (around line 659) hardcodes a kind→path map under PAPYRUS_ROOT, and ontology_enrichment.py reads files from the repo root. The published papyrus-newsroom wheel does not include them, so neither a PyPI install nor a container job nor a local pod without a Papyrus checkout can run the research, reporting, summarisation or ontology procedures. This was found while packaging the cloud knowledge run (Papyrus #596).

Fix:
- Move the .tac files into package data, as #596 did for corpora/, keeping a repo-path symlink or override for checkouts.
- Load them with importlib.resources.
- Replace the hardcoded map with one data registry of procedure kind → packaged file, extending papyrus-required-procedures.json or adding a sibling file.

Acceptance:
- A wheel-content test that every registered kind's file is packaged.
- A test that the kind lookup works from an unpacked wheel away from the checkout.
- Gherkin specs.
